full_prompt_en: A square abstract geometric painting presents interlocking circles, arcs, and tall rectangles against a nearly black ground. A broad pale blue-green circular disk dominates the upper right and center, cropped by the top edge and partially hidden by warmer forms. Inside its right half, a deep teal crescent curves around a small near-black oval. At the left, a pale tan arc sweeps down from the upper center toward the lower left, while a burnt orange semicircle sits behind it. Several narrow upright bars cross the central area, one light ocher rectangle descending from the top and another cream block positioned farther right. A long warm ocher vertical strip continues downward into the lower center, intersecting rust red, dark green, and blue-gray planes. Near the bottom, an orange curved edge loops around the disk and disappears behind a dark rectangular base. The shapes overlap without cast shadows; depth comes from crisp occlusion and subtle shifts in grain and saturation. Most edges are straight and clean, with the larger circular contours providing a slow counter-rhythm. The surface is matte and gently mottled, like pigments pressed into textured paper. Light is evenly distributed rather than directional, though warm rectangles appear slightly brighter than the cool surrounding fields. The image feels compact and balanced: a large cool round form is held by slender warm bars, dark cutouts, and a few pale intervals. The black margin around the assembled shapes keeps the layered center distinct and quiet.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形抽象几何绘画在近黑底面前呈现咬合的圆、弧和高窄矩形。宽阔浅蓝绿色圆盘占上部右侧与中央，受上缘裁切，并被较暖形块局部遮住。圆盘右半内部，一道深青绿新月围住小小近黑椭圆。左侧一道浅褐弧从上部中央扫向左下，背后坐着焦橘色半圆。几根狭长竖条穿过中央，一块浅赭矩形从顶端落下，另一块奶油色矩形位于更右。长暖赭色竖带继续伸到下部中央，与铁锈红、深绿和蓝灰平面交叉。下方一条橘色弧边绕过圆盘，又消失在深色矩形底块后。形块互叠但没有投影；纵深来自干净遮挡以及颗粒与饱和度的细微变化。大部分边缘笔直清楚，更大的圆形轮廓提供缓慢对位节奏。表面哑光、轻微斑驳，像颜料压进有纹理的纸。光分布均匀，并不定向，不过暖色矩形比周围冷色域稍亮。图像紧凑平衡：大型冷色圆形被细长暖条、深色缺口和几段浅色间隙牵住。组合形块周围的黑色留边让层叠中央清楚而安静。
style_prompt_en: A matte geometric abstraction builds a compact central assembly from broad circles, partial arcs, upright rectangles, and dark cutouts. Muted teal and blue-gray fields counter rust orange, ocher, cream, and near-black. Edges are clean and sharply overlapped; depth comes from occlusion and slight changes in surface grain, without perspective or cast shadows. Slender vertical bars punctuate the larger rounded movement, while small pale areas add measured intervals of light. Pigment-like mottling softens otherwise precise forms, giving the flat planes a tactile printed quality. Illumination is even and internal to the color values rather than a visible light source. A generous dark surround isolates the central structure and keeps the rhythmic crossings legible. The composition is quiet but interlocked, balancing slow curves against quick straight cuts and cool mass against warm accents.
style_prompt_zh: 哑光几何抽象以宽圆、局部弧线、竖向矩形及深色缺口拼出紧凑中央组合。低饱和青绿与蓝灰色域对照铁锈橘、赭色、奶油色和近黑。边缘干净、遮叠分明；纵深来自遮挡和表面颗粒的轻微变化，没有透视或投影。细长竖条点破较大圆形走势，小块浅色增加有节制的亮度间隔。颜料般斑驳柔化原本精确的形体，让平面具有可触的印刷质感。照明均匀，藏在色值关系中，而非来自可见光源。宽裕深色外围隔开中央结构，让节奏性交叉清楚可读。构图安静却互相咬合，以缓慢曲线平衡迅捷直切，以冷色大块平衡暖色重音。
theme_en: Overlapping circles and rectangles in muted teal and ocher
theme_zh: 低饱和青绿与赭色交叠的圆和矩形
name: Bela Kadar
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
